levelNote: The {{level}}s are level cards: they BEAT ACES and lose only to the jokers. The two hearts among them are wild and stand in for any card except a joker.
advanceNote: Going out first and second climbs {{first}} levels, first and third {{third}}, first and fourth {{fourth}}. There is no climb of three.
tableEmpty: Table: clear — lead anything you like
tributeCancelled: Tribute is off this hand: a payer held both red jokers.
tributeRules: Pick one card from your hand to give back in exchange.
handResultFirstSecond: First AND second: team {{team}} advances {{advance}} levels — now at {{level}}

tutorial.info: The hand number and this hand's level. Level cards beat aces, and the two hearts among them are wild.
tutorial.players: Each seat's team, cards left, and finishing position. Partners sit opposite each other.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Select the cards that form a combination, then press Play.
tutorial.actions: You may only play a combination that beats the one on the table. When the table is clear you must lead, not pass.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset the game at any time with this button.
